description: Defines the interface and class for a GPU memory buffer video frame pool that manages GpuMemoryBuffer-backed VideoFrames, including creation and shared image management.

classes.name: RenderableGpuMemoryBufferVideoFramePool
classes.description: A class that manages a pool of GPU memory buffer-backed video frames, providing creation and management functionalities.

classes.name: RenderableGpuMemoryBufferVideoFramePool::Context
classes.description: An interface for GPU-related operations such as creating GPU memory buffers and shared images, primarily for testing purposes.

methods.name: RenderableGpuMemoryBufferVideoFramePool::Create
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the video frame pool with the provided GPU context.

methods.name: RenderableGpuMemoryBufferVideoFramePool::MaybeCreateVideoFrame
methods.description: Returns a GPU memory buffer-backed VideoFrame suitable for rendering, or nullptr if unsupported or context is lost.
